Loads v3 = float at a3+4, then classifies it against an upper threshold (this+12, field evidence this+0xC) and a lower threshold (this+444, field evidence this+0x1BC). If v3 <= this+444 no action is taken (lower zone, blocked). If v3 is in (this+444, a2] ArithmeticComparison_3a90 is called with (this+440, a3). If v3 > a2 and v3 < this+12, ArithmeticComparison_3a90 is called with (this+8, a3). Used for zone/region state management; called by NetworkMessageDispatch (004b54e0) and sub_4B9000 (004b9000).
